name: Glam platform shoe
summary: The raised shoe of glam rock and disco. It has a platform sole of 5 to 10 cm, a thick heel, and a loud upper in patent, glitter, suede or snake print.

philosophy.core_thesis: A glam shoe adds height and noise: a thick platform and a bright upper make the wearer taller, louder and not quite real.
design_principles: Raise the sole 5 to 10 cm at the toe, with a heel 2 to 4 cm higher than the platform.
Cut the platform in layers of cork, wood or foam, and cover them in leather or cloth.
Use a rounded or a squared toe, and a wide, solid heel.
Cover the upper in a loud material: patent, glitter, mirror, snake print or metallic.
Add stars, stripes or a stacked sole in two or three colours.
Close the shoe with a thick ankle strap, a buckle, or a high lace shaft.
Match the platform edge to the upper in colour, or contrast it on purpose.
anti_patterns: A single muted colour and a thin heel

silhouette.shape: A heavy, tall shoe: a thick platform, a wide heel and a short vamp that sits on top.
silhouette.line: A strong, stepped line: the platform edge, the heel and the upper in blocks of colour.
silhouette.fit: Snug at the instep and the ankle, with a strap to hold the foot over the thick sole.
silhouette.proportion: Platform 5 to 10 cm; heel 9 to 15 cm; the ratio of platform to heel about 1 to 2.
rules: Keep the platform thick and the heel wide.
Wear it with flared or wide trousers that show the sole.
Use two colours or more on the sole.
Add a strap at the ankle for a sandal or mule.

fabrics.rule: Use patent, suede and satin for the upper, and add snake skin, vinyl and clear acrylic for show. Build the sole from layers of wood, cork or foam.

methods: built-up platform of layered cork or wood
covered platform in leather or vinyl
hand lasting over a platform last
ankle strap riveted to the quarter
construction.closures: An ankle strap with a buckle, a lace shaft, or a zip at the side of a boot.
construction.details: A stacked and striped platform, a glitter or mirror vamp, a star motif, a buckled ankle strap and a wide block heel.

surface.pattern: Loud and graphic: stars, stripes, snake print, glitter and mirror pieces.
surface.gloss: Patent and vinyl at 80–95 GU; glitter and mirror at 90–100 GU; suede at 2–5 GU.
surface.wear: The shoe shows its age quickly: peeling vinyl and chipped paint look tired, but scuffs on a platform are normal.

palette.strategy: Bold, high-chroma colours and metals, in blocks and stripes.

processes: covering the platform in leather or vinyl
making.scale: Made by small London shoemakers and by factories for the high street, in thousands of pairs for each season.
making.signs: A thick, even platform, a bright and clean cover, a firm strap and a stable heel.

pieces.form: Platform shoe with a stacked, striped sole
Platform shoe in snake skin on a wide heel
Platform ankle boot in suede with a high shaft
Platform sandal in satin with an ankle strap
Platform mule in vinyl with a printed star

evidence.title: Women's Charles Jourdan Green Platform Shoes (DPLA)

emotion.target_response: A feeling of play and swagger: tall, loud and glittering, a shoe that makes an entrance.

use_cases: a costume brief for a 1970s glam or disco film
a stage costume for a rock performer
avoid_when: the brief wants a quiet dress shoe
the brief wants a thin heel
the brief wants a sports shoe

modifiers.how: Remove the platform, thin the heel to a spike, and use plain black kid.
Remove the glitter, use black calf, and fit a lace shaft with a thick lug sole.
